_note: The pet's lines for every Digimon of a stage (PetBrain.stage_key: baby = Fresh and In-Training); his own few (own.json) join them. Rows split at line breaks; at most 3 rows under the name, each must fit DW1's text box (tests: test_pet_lines, tools/check_pet_lines.gd). DW1's font has letters, digits and . , : ; ? ! ' + - = only; two spaces between sentences.
greet:
Hi!  Let's do our best
today!

You're here!  I've been
waiting all morning!

Ready when you are!
What are we doing?
morning:
Good morning!  Did you
sleep well?
night:
It's getting late...
Aren't you tired?

Still working?  I'll
stay up with you.

Back in File City,
everyone's asleep now.
talk:
Jijimon says we'll save
File City together.

I want to get stronger
and evolve!

Training makes me hungry.
Is it meat time yet?

Your screen is so bright.
Is it always like this?

When I'm bigger, I'll
protect you.  Promise!

I wonder what I'll
evolve into...

There's so much to see
out here!

Let's take a walk later.
After your work.
praise:
Really?  Thanks!  I'll
keep it up!

Hehe!  That makes me
so happy!

Yes!  I knew I could
do it!

I won't do it again.
Probably.
read:
What are all these
words about?

Is this a map?  It
doesn't look like one.

long one!

All done!  Let's

Let's try again!

Don't give up!
I'm right here.

See you there!
